authority: POS is authoritative for what the merchant recorded at sale; acquirer/ledger authorities govern final payment and accounting.
schema_semantics: line price, discount, tax, fee and tender must remain distinct
original and current order states are both required
currency and unit semantics are explicit
time_order_finality: business event time differs from ingestion and settlement time
voids and returns compensate rather than erase
offline terminals may upload late
receipt sequence is location/register scoped

authority: OMS is authoritative for commercial-order workflow, not necessarily inventory, parcel delivery or settled cash.
schema_semantics: order header and lines have separate state
substitution and split shipment preserve lineage
source and sales channel must be retained
time_order_finality: created, accepted, promised, allocated, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned and financially closed are different times
late events and corrections are normal
finality is per obligation

authority: PIM/catalog owner is authoritative for approved sellable definitions; supplier data and channel renditions remain separately provenance-stamped.
schema_semantics: GTIN/SKU/service IDs are not interchangeable
pack hierarchy and variants are explicit
source facts are separated from generated content
time_order_finality: valid time and publication time differ
regional/channel variants coexist
deletion may mean retirement not erasure

authority: Inventory ledger owns recorded stock states; physical reality is evidenced by scans/counts and may disagree.
schema_semantics: stock state, ownership, quality and location dimensions remain distinct
base unit and pack conversion are versioned
room/service capacity is not fungible physical stock
time_order_finality: quantity has effective and recorded time
availability is derived and policy-dependent
counts correct prior beliefs
negative stock may be permitted or anomalous

authority: ERP owns approved procurement documents and accounting postings; warehouse receipt and bank settlement may be separate authorities.
schema_semantics: ordered, received, invoiced and paid quantities/amounts are not collapsed
legal entity and purchasing organization scope all keys
time_order_finality: document, approval, goods-receipt, invoice, posting and payment times differ
period close can post adjustments
supplier master is slowly changing

authority: WMS owns warehouse task execution and recorded bin/container state.
schema_semantics: container nesting and split/merge lineage are preserved
planned and actual locations remain separate
reason codes are governed
time_order_finality: scan event time and server time differ
task state is mutable
shipment confirmation is not carrier acceptance
rework creates loops

authority: Dispatch/TMS owns assignments and plans; telematics and signed proof evidence actual movement/completion.
schema_semantics: pickup and delivery obligations are paired
travel-time model version is retained
location privacy and precision are explicit
time_order_finality: planned, predicted and actual times coexist
GPS is sampled and uncertain
proof may arrive offline
route solutions are proposals until accepted

authority: Approved pricing system owns eligible offers; accepted order/folio owns the contract actually transacted.
schema_semantics: list, offered, accepted, net and realized prices remain distinct
tax and fee inclusion is explicit
promotion stacking and funding are modeled
time_order_finality: decision, publish, display, accept and transact times differ
prices are market/channel/currency/eligibility scoped
corrections do not rewrite accepted contracts

authority: Merchandising owner governs approved assortment and placement intent; observed shelf/menu/channel state evidences execution.
schema_semantics: customer-facing taxonomy and operational category hierarchy are not assumed identical
planned facings and detected facings are separate observations
time_order_finality: planning season differs from effective selling period
approved and executed assortment differ
space geometry changes by store

authority: CRM/loyalty owners govern declared profiles and ledger entries; source channels own interaction observations; no system has unconditional person truth.
schema_semantics: observed, declared and inferred attributes are labeled
customer, guest, passenger and payer roles remain distinct
purpose/consent bind each use
time_order_finality: identity links are probabilistic/versioned
consent and purpose have valid time
points post, expire and reverse
profile deletion may be jurisdiction scoped

authority: Telemetry source owns observed instrumented events, not intent, causality or complete behavior.
schema_semantics: event and item scopes remain distinct
event version and collection surface are recorded
deduplication keys are explicit
time_order_finality: client event, server receipt and processing time differ
late/replayed events occur
identity and session windows are policy-derived
consent may revoke future collection

authority: Platforms own delivered/logged observations under their definitions; enterprise experiment/study owns causal claims.
schema_semantics: platform-reported attribution is not causal incrementality
exposure eligibility and delivered exposure differ
creative and claim versions are retained
time_order_finality: event time and attribution-window time differ
platform conversions may be modeled/revised
cost finalizes after fraud/credit adjustments

authority: Processor/acquirer owns payment processing observations; bank/ledger owns settled cash; merchant owns order legitimacy evidence.
schema_semantics: order amount, authorized amount, captured amount, settled amount and ledger amount are distinct
PCI scope and tokenization are recorded
time_order_finality: authorization is provisional
capture, clearing and settlement have separate finality
chargebacks arrive long after sale
token and instrument identifiers rotate

authority: Returns system governs reverse workflow; inspection evidences condition; payment/ledger governs refund finality.
schema_semantics: original sale/order line is retained
unit/serial identity where available
refund and physical disposition are not collapsed
time_order_finality: request, carrier acceptance, receipt, inspection, refund and disposition times differ
reason and observed defect may conflict

authority: Contract owner governs terms; POS evidences sell-out; ledger governs booked accrual/settlement.
schema_semantics: manufacturer funding, retailer discount and customer redemption remain separate
baseline method/version accompanies uplift claim
time_order_finality: promotion planning, sell-in, sell-out and claim periods differ
retroactive agreement changes occur
accrual finality follows settlement

authority: Sensor owns recorded signal; derived model owns detection with uncertainty; neither alone establishes business cause.
schema_semantics: raw signal/media and derived detection remain linked
sensor/unit/location identity is governed
confidence and model version are mandatory
time_order_finality: event time, exposure interval and processing time differ
sampling and occlusion create missingness
model outputs are probabilistic
device calibration has validity intervals

authority: Timekeeping owns recorded/approved work time; payroll owns paid results; operations owns task observations.
schema_semantics: worker identity and sensitive attributes are access controlled
actual hours are not inferred solely from schedules
skills and certifications have validity
time_order_finality: planned schedule, worked time, approved time and paid time differ
time zones/DST matter
retroactive corrections and pay adjustments occur

authority: Case platform owns workflow state; communication platform owns media/events; adjudicated resolution belongs to business policy owner.
schema_semantics: conversation, task, segment and case grains remain distinct
PII redaction and consent provenance accompany content
human and machine labels are distinguished
time_order_finality: arrival, queue, handle, wrap-up, resolution and reopen times differ
transcripts can be delayed/redacted
case reason can change

authority: PMS owns property stay workflow and folio postings; CRS/channel owns upstream offer/reservation messages.
schema_semantics: reservation is not stay and stay is not guest
room type and physical room remain distinct
original and current rate/folio are retained
time_order_finality: hotel business date differs from wall-clock date
reservation, arrival, in-house, departure and no-show states mutate
night audit can post adjustments

authority: Property revenue owner approves ARI; channel manager evidences publication; OTA owns customer-channel transaction observations.
schema_semantics: canonical and channel room/rate codes are mapped with version
gross/net/tax-inclusive prices are explicit
time_order_finality: effective stay date differs from publish/receive time
availability messages race reservations
acknowledgements can fail or lag

authority: Housekeeping/engineering systems own task execution; PMS governs saleable room state under property policy.
schema_semantics: room cleanliness, occupancy and maintenance availability are separate
task reassignment history is retained
time_order_finality: assigned, started, paused, completed and inspected times differ
room readiness depends on multiple task and status states

authority: Airline offer/order system governs accepted travel obligations; operational delivery and settlement remain separate authorities.
schema_semantics: PNR/ticket/EMD legacy artifacts are mapped without becoming canonical concepts
passenger, payer and traveler roles remain distinct
time_order_finality: offer expiry, acceptance, fulfillment and accounting are separate
irregular operations modify obligations
exchange/refund creates lineage

authority: Airline/airport operational systems own their event observations; collaborative milestones are shared claims with provenance.
schema_semantics: operational time qualifier is mandatory
airport local time and UTC retained
codeshare marketing and operating identities differ
time_order_finality: scheduled, target, estimated and actual times are separate and revised
flight-leg identity survives some schedule changes
causes may be assigned after event

authority: DCS owns passenger processing; baggage system owns recorded custody; physical handoff can remain unobserved if scan absent.
schema_semantics: bag, passenger, segment and journey identities remain related but distinct
required custody points are explicit
time_order_finality: custody scans can arrive late or be missing
connection windows use scheduled and actual time
delivery closes separately from flight arrival

authority: Supplier reservation system governs confirmed capacity obligation; intermediary owns search and booking observations.
schema_semantics: quote/offer and confirmed reservation are separate
supplier and reseller identifiers are mapped
cancellation and refund states differ
time_order_finality: search availability is ephemeral
supplier confirmation may be asynchronous
local service time and booking time differ

authority: KDS owns kitchen workflow observations; POS owns commercial order; handoff platform owns delivery/customer receipt evidence.
schema_semantics: guest check, kitchen ticket, item and production batch grains remain separate
remake/reason lineage is retained
time_order_finality: order, send, fire, start, ready and handoff times differ
courses and items may be re-fired
offline tickets reconcile late

authority: Food-safety plan owner defines controls; calibrated observation and signed verification evidence execution.
schema_semantics: critical limit and observed value include unit/method
missing observation is not compliant observation
lot/process linkage is mandatory
time_order_finality: observation, review and corrective action times differ
sensor calibration has validity
continuous and spot checks have different coverage

authority: Booking owns reserved slot; field-service workflow owns execution; customer acceptance and finance close separately.
hazards: repeat visit under new work order
schema_semantics: appointment and work order are distinct
first visit and repeat visit link
asset/service history is effective-dated
time_order_finality: requested, promised, dispatched, arrival, service and completion times differ
reschedule/cancel history is retained
notes can sync late

authority: Each publisher owns its observation under stated methodology; enterprise mapping and derived features remain internal claims.
schema_semantics: external observations are provenance-stamped and never silently treated as enterprise truth
point, area and network geographies are distinguished
time_order_finality: publication, valid and revision times differ
forecast vintage must be retained
geographic support and resolution vary

authority: Gateway records model behavior; domain owner/human remains authority for product, safety, pricing, customer or operational decisions.
schema_semantics: generated claims cite source spans when applicable
raw source, extraction and generation remain separate
PII/use authorization travels with content
time_order_finality: model and prompt versions are immutable identifiers
outputs are non-final proposals
retrieval and tool observations retain source time
provider retention policy is explicit
